name: Image Membrane
doc: The picture forms a wave tank whose luma sets ripple speed and whose edges damp the wake. Kicks strike the tank and the changing surface bends the picture into caustics and nodal lines.

in.doc: the picture refracted by the wave surface

height.doc: brighter pixels propagate the wave faster

flow.doc: hard picture edges damp the wave

bend.doc: how far the waves refract the image
